entities.name: Georg Gürich
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Georg Julius Ernst Gürich was a German geologist, paleontologist and university teacher, who wrote on Paleozoic geological formations in Poland and ranged through Guinea, Tanzania and Southern Africa, in search of unrecorded new species.
